description: Source code for the ExecPlugin class in the kustomize project, implementing plugin execution, configuration, and transformation logic.

classes.name: ExecPlugin
classes.description: Represents an executable plugin with methods to configure, validate, generate, and transform resources.

methods.name: NewExecPlugin
methods.description: Creates a new ExecPlugin instance with the specified path.

methods.name: ErrIfNotExecutable
methods.description: Checks if the plugin file is executable.

methods.name: Args
methods.description: Returns the command-line arguments for the plugin.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Sets the plugin's helpers and configuration, processes optional args fields.

methods.name: processOptionalArgsFields
methods.description: Parses argsOneLiner and argsFromFile from the plugin configuration.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Runs the plugin to generate resources and returns a ResMap.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms a ResMap using the plugin.

methods.name: invokePlugin
methods.description: Executes the plugin binary with the configuration file and input, returns output.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Prepares environment variables for plugin execution.
